run_upload_script: run the upload.py script to submit diffs from Git, Mercurial, or Subversion to a code review server
create_issue_codereview: create a new code review issue with a subject message and optional reviewers on the codereview server
upload_separate_patches: upload separate patches for each file in the diff output when the patch exceeds the maximum upload size
guess_vcs_type: guess the version control system from the current working directory and return the appropriate VCS instance
split_patch_data: split a unified diff patch into separate pieces for each file contained in the diff output
encode_multipart_formdata: encode form fields and files into a multipart/form-data body with a boundary separator for HTTP uploads
run_shell_command: run a shell command and return its stdout output along with the process return code
authenticate_rpc_server: authenticate with the code review server using Google ClientLogin and save authentication cookies
